Class Player

java.lang.Object
Player
public class Player extends Object
Tracks the data related to the Player's character.

Tracks and manages their hp, gold, Inventory, Position, and cause of death.

  • Method Details

    • damage

      public void damage(double dmg)
      Deals damage to the Player.
      Parameters:
      dmg - the amount of damage to deal to the Player's current hp.

    • useItem

      public String[] useItem()
      Uses the Item the Player is currently holding. Returns an array of error messages depending on why the Item could not be used. The error message is printed at the next call of printChoicePrompt to notify the Player. If there was no error, an empty String array is returned causing no errors to print.
      Returns:
      array of error messages stating why the Item could not be used.

    • heal

      public String[] heal()
      Attempts to use the Player's held Item to heal. On a success, it reduces the quantity of the Item. If the quantity drops to 0, the held item gets updated. On a fail, it returns an array of error messages stating why it failed. If there was no error, an empty String array is returned causing no errors to print.
      Returns:
      array of error messages stating why the Item could not be used.

    • updateItemOnHand

      public void updateItemOnHand()
      Updates which Item the Player is holding. Removes the current Item that reached quantity 0. If there is another Item available in the inventory, it switches the held Item to the first one.

    • previousItem

      public String previousItem()
      Switches the held Item to the previous one in the Inventory. Wraps back around to the last Item on the list if the held Item is the first. Returns an error message if there are no Items left.
      Returns:
      an error message stating there are no Items left.

    • pickUpItem

      public void pickUpItem(Item item)
      Adds an item obtained through looting or shopping to the inventory.
      Parameters:
      item - the item obtained through looting or shopping.

    • nextItem

      public String nextItem()
      Switches the held Item to the next one in the Inventory. Wraps back around to the first Item on the list if the held Item is the last. Returns an error message if there are no Items left.
      Returns:
      an error message stating there are no Items left.
